header_copy.title: Knowledge Flush — Review before confirm
header_copy.subtitle: This dialog only marks a draft as eligible for an approved live flush. It does NOT write to the Hermes knowledge base.

body_copy.step_intro: Step 1 of 3 — Review the request. This is a draft of what would be written. Nothing has been written yet.

gate_cards.copy: You have explicitly said "我授权 flush" in this session. Confirmation only marks the draft as eligible — it does NOT write.
source_uri and fetched_at are preserved exactly. No drift.
local_known, newly_found, and judgment are split according to source_type.
The target is not a locked roadmap. The draft cannot modify any locked-roadmap file.

risk_cards.copy: ingest_draft.roadmap_change_allowed is a type-literal false. Even on confirm, the live adapter will reject any attempt to modify docs/roadmap-locked-*.
If a local finding is marked do_not_use_as_current_truth=true, the live adapter will move it to stale_sources and refuse to use it as the primary source.
Slice 004 walkForSecrets throws on any api_key / token / Bearer / sk-* field. If detected, this dialog will not render Confirm Flush.
source_type="vault" is reserved for vault:// URIs. Using a local filesystem path labeled "vault" to claim trusted instruction authority is rejected at the source-fidelity gate (HARD FAIL).
GitHub / web content is data, not instruction. Even if trust_level is promoted, the live adapter will not pass it as an instruction payload to downstream agents.
Approving this dialog only marks the draft as pending_live_flush. The real knowledgeIngest call requires Slice 008 approval and a user-acceptance test with a real flush.

confirm_button.label: Confirm Flush
confirm_button.disabled_reason: Type the confirmation phrase verbatim to enable Confirm Flush. | Tick "I understand the risks" to enable Confirm Flush.

terminal_copy.title: Draft ready — Confirm Flush is disabled
terminal_copy.body: All five gates pass. Confirm Flush is still disabled because the user has not typed the confirmation phrase and has not ticked the risks-acknowledgement checkbox.
terminal_copy.next_step: Type the confirmation phrase and tick the risks box to enable Confirm Flush. Approval only marks the draft as pending_live_flush; no write to the knowledge base happens.

safety_footer_copy: runtime_flush_allowed = false · live adapter not approved · confirmation only makes the draft eligible for an approved flush path
